<!-- rivetari-judge-review round=1 -->
### Rivetari judge · round 1 · approve

#### Acceptance
- A1: met — New root .gitattributes contains exactly the line '.rivetari/** text eol=lf'.
- A2: met — .factory/skills.state.json is deleted. The card says it was the only tracked file under .factory/ after PR #4 removed .factory/.gitignore, so .factory/ no longer exists.
- A3: met — The diff touches only .gitattributes (added) and .factory/skills.state.json (deleted). No protected path is touched.

<details><summary>1 suggestion(s), non-blocking</summary>

- Existing Windows checkouts keep their CRLF copies until files are re-checked out `.gitattributes:1` — Mention in the PR body that existing clones should run `git rm --cached -r .rivetari && git reset --hard`, or delete and re-checkout `.rivetari/`. Optionally run `git add --renormalize .rivetari` once to confirm the index already holds LF.

</details>

suggestions.title: Existing Windows checkouts keep their CRLF copies until files are re-checked out
suggestions.detail: Adding the .gitattributes rule changes how files are checked out from now on. Working trees that already hold CRLF copies of .rivetari/** files are not rewritten automatically, so Rivetari's ledger verification can keep failing there after this merges. This diff does not cause that, but the fix is not visible on those machines until they refresh.
suggestions.repro: On a Windows clone with core.autocrlf=true that already has .rivetari/ files checked out with CRLF, pull this change and run Rivetari's verification. The CRLF copies are still on disk.
suggestions.fix: Mention in the PR body that existing clones should run `git rm --cached -r .rivetari && git reset --hard`, or delete and re-checkout `.rivetari/`. Optionally run `git add --renormalize .rivetari` once to confirm the index already holds LF.

The diff touches only .gitattributes (added) and .factory/skills.state.json (deleted). No protected path is touched.
